summary.text: Tou Xiong is a Democratic-Farmer-Labor member of the Minnesota Senate for District 44, elected to the Senate in 2022 after being elected to the House in 2018 and re-elected in 2020.
His official Senate page lists committee assignments including State and Local Government, Energy, Utilities, Environment, and Climate, and Capital Investment.

sources.title: Senator Tou Xiong (44, DFL) - Minnesota Senate
